text:
maya.sales: Heads-up: Enterprise POC with Nova Robotics. They want a 3-month Dedicated commit across us-west1 + asia-southeast1. Proposed reserved capacity = 64 A100-equivalent units total, with autoscale and burst enabled to 1.25x for short bursts. Ask: approve a one-time POC burst cap and a 15% commit discount. Need to kick off infra in ~10 days.
tom.revenue: Put the raw $ numbers here so finance can assess. Also need to know if asia region has capacity.
maya.sales: Proposed commercial: $85k/mo committed (combined), 15% discount from sticker, burst cap billing limited to POC for 30 days. If we do the 15% discount, committed ARR is $867k for 12 months pro forma (but this is 3-month POC first).
liam.finance: Quick check: at 15% discount, margin impact looks OK if POC traffic is limited. However, asia-southeast has higher infra ops cost. We need a burst exposure calc. @ops-bot can you simulate 1.25x burst on expected POC traffic?
ops-bot: Simulation: baseline token throughput estimate = 3.2M tokens/day. Burst to 1.25x for 20% of peak => incremental cost ~ $6.2k/mo. Total estimated monthly invoice during POC window = $72.5k (after discount). Note: asia region surge cost multipliers applied.
kevin.eng: From eng side: autoscale config is fine. However, asia-southeast spare pool is limited. We can offer best-effort burst for POC but cannot guarantee dedicated spare capacity without a short-term reservation that would cost extra. For POC, recommend limiting guaranteed burst to us-west only.
maya.sales: Can we compromise: allow 1.25x guaranteed in us-west, best-effort in asia, and include an explicit clause in SOW? Also need deal-desk sign-off on the 15% discount.
liam.finance: Agree to conditional approval: 15% discount for POC if legal adds an invoice reconciliation clause, and if customer signs SOW acknowledging best-effort in asia. Also require PO in advance for the POC period.
gina.legal: Draft clause suggestion: "POC Period (max 30 days): Customer may exceed reserved capacity up to 125% of reserved units. Excess usage during the POC will be billed at the capped burst rate. Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to serve burst capacity in all regions; however, availability in certain regions (e.g., asia-southeast1) is not guaranteed. Customer consents to potential throttling in constrained regions and agrees to cooperate with Redwood to reschedule cross-region traffic if required." I can tailor language for SOW.
liam.finance: Addendum procedural note: we will create a special price code for the POC to track revenue and expense separately. Finance will need SOW with region breakout and expected token estimates.
Deal-desk: Approved per conditions: 1) 15% limited discount for POC only, 2) burst cap 1.25x (guaranteed us-west, best-effort asia), 3) PO in advance, 4) legal addendum signed. Final sign-off after SOW uploaded to the deal ticket.
maya.sales: Great — I'll upload SOW + token forecasts and PO by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
tom.revenue: Also set a 14-day review checkpoint in CRM to determine conversion to committed production or termination.
maya.sales: Noted. Will ping again once SOW is in.
